outline.subject: Ferdinand Schörner was a German general and field marshal in the Wehrmacht during the Second World War.

sections.title: Ferdinand Schörner
sections.covers: This section provides an overview of the subject's military career, his reputation among historians, and his post-war legal proceedings.

sections.title: Early life
sections.covers: This section details the subject's birth, early military service in the Bavarian Army, and his activities during the First World War and the interwar period.

sections.title: World War II
sections.covers: This section describes the subject's various command roles throughout the war, his promotion to field marshal, his actions during the final surrender, and his subsequent imprisonment and release.

sections.title: Assessment
sections.covers: This section discusses the subject's reputation for brutality, his strict enforcement of discipline, and his political loyalty to the Nazi regime.

sections.title: Awards and decorations
